title: Deterministic runs under state renaming
statement: Let $S$ and $H$ be state sets, let $\Gamma$ be an alphabet, and let $k$ be the number of work tapes. Suppose $M_{\mathrm{src}}$ is a deterministic multi-tape machine over $\Gamma$ with state set $S$, and $M_{\mathrm{host}}$ is a nondeterministic multi-tape machine over $\Gamma$ with state set $H$. Let $e:S\hookrightarrow H$ be an embedding and $G\subseteq S$. Assume that for every choice bit, every $q\in G$, and every input and work-tape reading, the host transition at $e(q)$ equals the deterministic source transition at $q$ with its successor state renamed by $e$. For a source configuration $c$ on input $x$ and a choice word $w$, suppose every state reached by the deterministic source run after $u$ steps belongs to $G$ whenever $u<|w|$ and that run has a state. Then the host run from $e(c)$ under $w$ equals the deterministic source configuration after $|w|$ steps, with its state renamed by $e$.
